request._comment: Transit parameter, consumed by this capacity. It may arrive as a value or as a transit reference; the contract declares only its name and schema (/root/llm/schema/request), and it is read through the parameter resolver.

response._comment: Transit result, consumed by the caller (/root/llm/schema/response). Never persisted by this capacity.

#adapt_request.role: Build the OpenAI Responses API HTTP request from the canonical request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes an OpenAI Responses API request.
notes: request.messages -> body.input, preserving message order, role and content.
request.requirements.reasoning -> body.reasoning.effort when present and supported by the requested model.
When request.output.format is absent or 'text', body.text.format = {"type":"text"}.
request.parameters.stop has no direct mapping in the Responses API contract used by this capacity; if supplied, the capacity fails rather than silently changing its meaning.
No canonical field is silently converted into provider-specific semantic instructions.

#execute.role: Execute the OpenAI Responses API request asynchronously.

transformation_contract.morphing: An OpenAI API request becomes an OpenAI API response.
notes: Measure duration immediately around the remote API call.
HTTP authentication errors, transport errors and provider failures propagate as Brique errors.
Credential values are never copied into returned diagnostic information.

#normalize_response.role: Normalize the OpenAI Responses API result into /root/llm/schema/response.

transformation_contract.morphing: An OpenAI Responses API result becomes a canonical inference response.
notes: Collect text from provider_response.output message content blocks whose type is 'output_text'.
For format 'text', response.output.content is the resulting text.
For format 'json' or 'json_schema', parse the generated JSON text and place the parsed value in response.output.content.
response.output.format is the effective canonical output format.
A provider status of 'failed' or 'cancelled' becomes a Brique error instead of a successful canonical response.

#root.role: Adapt a canonical LLM request to the OpenAI Responses API, execute it asynchronously, and normalize the result to the canonical response schema.

failure: The request contains a canonical feature that cannot be represented by the OpenAI Responses API.
The OpenAI response cannot be normalized to /root/llm/schema/response.
invariants: request.model is forwarded unchanged as the requested OpenAI model.
The canonical cognitive content is not rewritten.
OpenAI-specific representation remains internal to this capacity.
The capacity is stateless between invocations.
The request and the response are transit values: no Matter is read, written or created, and nothing is persisted.

A transient failure of the provider (a rate limit 429, an overload 529, a server error 5xx, a request timeout 408, a broken connection) is asked again up to three times, waiting longer each time (the Retry-After of the provider when it gives one); any other error is returned at once.
transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes a canonical inference response produced through OpenAI.

description: Execute a canonical inference request through OpenAI and return a canonical inference response.
Execute a canonical inference request through the OpenAI Responses API and return a canonical inference response.
